description: President Masoud Pezeshkian said his country would not give up its civilian nuclear program, but left the door opened for diplomacy with the United States.

description: The 34-year-old has been recovering from an on-pitch collapse in June during a friendly between Denmark and Ukraine.

title: Board of Peace plans $2.4bn Gaza reconstruction as Israel kills seven
description: Violations against Palestinians in Gaza continue even as world leaders call on Israel to adhere to ceasefire deal.

title: Ancient Wall Found in Paris Provides Clues to City’s Origins
description: A discovery at a Parisian hospital, on an island in the Seine, has given archaeologists clues about the city as Julius Caesar may have found it.

title: A mass shooting at a house party in South Africa kills 11, including a pregnant woman
description: Three gunmen opened fire at a house party in South Africa, resulting in 11 deaths, including a pregnant woman. Authorities are searching for the suspects.

description: Russia attacked Kyiv with drones, resulting in two deaths and 23 injuries, just hours before President Zelenskyy addressed the UN General Assembly. Ukraine responded by targeting Russian oil refineries.

description: Saudi Arabia is leading hotel expansion in the Middle East with 110,000 rooms under development, accounting for about 50% of the region’s hotel pipeline.
